svg.title: The League of Amazing Programmers — horizontal arced wordmark
svg.desc: Self-contained (embedded font + raster) horizontal lock-up: straight "THE LEAGUE OF" / "PROGRAMMERS" flanking an arced "AMAZING", with the League bolt (traced from assets/logos/bolt.png) bookending the top line. See logo-arced.md for how this was built.

g.text: SMART MINDS · BOLD IDEAS · BRIGHT FUTURES
